memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: GlobalMart has two date dimensions, and choosing the wrong one silently changes the answer.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `transaction_date` for operational questions: daily sales, footfall, stock movement. It is when the transaction happened.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `fiscal_date` for anything compared against a budget or reported by period, because the fiscal year does not start in January.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a date dimension (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: When a question says "last quarter" in a financial context it means a fiscal quarter, so group by `fiscal_date`.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a date dimension

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Three metrics have "revenue" in the name and they are not interchangeable.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Use `metric_l1_total_net_revenue` by default. Net revenue is after returns and discounts.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: `metric_l1_sql_margin_bridge_gross_revenue` is gross, before returns and discounts. It exists for the margin bridge and is the wrong figure elsewhere.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Choosing a revenue metric (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: `metric_l1_sql_net_sales_summary_net_revenue` agrees with total net revenue but is scoped to its own SQL dataset's grain, so it does not slice by every dimension.
memoryItems.title: Choosing a revenue metric

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: GlobalMart's metrics are layered, and the layer is in both the metric id and its tags, L1 through L5.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L1 metrics (`metric_l1_*`) are base aggregations over a single fact column. They are the only layer that touches a fact directly.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L2 metrics (`metric_l2_cross_*`) are ratios between two L1 metrics, such as order count over net revenue.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L3 metrics (`metric_l3_*`) apply a filter to an L1 or L2 metric, usually a WHERE on a dimension attribute such as channel type.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: L4 and L5 metrics compose further on top of the lower layers.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

memoryItems.description: GlobalMart metric conventions › Metric layers (compiled from docs/knowledge/metric-hierarchy.md)
memoryItems.instruction: Prefer the lowest layer that answers the question. Total net revenue is an L1 metric; net revenue for one channel is an existing L3 metric, not an L1 metric with a filter added.
memoryItems.title: Metric layers

metrics.description: Sums the Markdown Amount from the Markdown Event data to show the total value of markdowns over the selected scope (such as time period, store, or product). Use it to track overall markdown impact and compare it across different dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Markdown Amount (Markdown Event)

metrics.description: Shows the overall planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) compliance total by summing the Compliance Score across the Planogram Compliance data, based on the current analysis scope (such as selected filters, locations, or time period). Use it to compare total compliance levels across different cuts of the business.
metrics.title: Total Compliance Score (Planogram Compliance)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of days items were out of stock based on the Planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) Compliance data. Use it to quantify stock-out impact and compare availability issues over time or across stores, products, and other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Out of Stock Days (Planogram Compliance)

metrics.description: Shows the total margin by summing Margin from the Daily Product Performance data, so you can track profitability across the selected dates, products, or other applied filters.
metrics.title: Total Margin (Daily Product Performance)

metrics.description: Sums the Avg Rating values from the Product Rating dataset to show the overall total rating across the currently selected products and any applied time or other filters.
metrics.title: Total Avg Rating (Product Rating)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of product rating reviews by summing the Review Count from the Product Rating dataset. Use it to track and compare review volume across products, time periods, or other segments.
metrics.title: Total Review Count (Product Rating)

metrics.description: Sums the Decision Count from the Range Review Outcome dataset to show the total number of decisions recorded. Use it to monitor overall decision volume and compare it across time periods, product categories, or other reporting dimensions.
metrics.title: Total Decision Count (Range Review Outcome)

metrics.description: Shows the total average inventory by summing Avg Inventory from the Assortment Efficiency data for the current analysis context (such as selected time period, products, or locations). Use it to monitor overall inventory levels when evaluating assortment efficiency.
metrics.title: Total Avg Inventory (Assortment Efficiency)

metrics.description: Overall sell-through rate for the selected scope, calculated by summing Sell-Through Rate values from the Assortment Efficiency dataset. Use it to assess how effectively inventory is being sold under the current filters and grouping.
metrics.title: Total Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency)

metrics.description: Shows the total number of units sold by summing Units Sold from the Assortment Efficiency dataset. Use it to track and compare overall sales volume in units across the available Assortment Efficiency dimensions (for example by product, store, or time period).
metrics.title: Total Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency)

metrics.description: Measures the gap between sales volume and profitability by subtracting Total Margin (Daily Product Performance) from Total Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) for the current filters. Use it as a directional indicator to spot products, dates, or other slices where unit movement and margin are out of balance.
metrics.title: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) vs Margin (Daily Product Performance) Change

metrics.description: Shows the net impact of markdowns on profitability by subtracting total markdown amount from total margin. Use it to understand how much margin remains (or is eroded) after markdown events for the currently selected products, dates, stores, or other filters.
metrics.title: Margin (Daily Product Performance) vs Markdown Amount (Markdown Event) Change

metrics.description: Net difference between total markdown amount from Markdown Events and the total planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) compliance score for the current selection (such as time, store, or product). Use it to compare whether markdown activity is increasing faster or slower than compliance performance under the same filters.
metrics.title: Markdown Amount (Markdown Event) vs Compliance Score (Planogram Compliance) Change

metrics.description: Compares overall Planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) Compliance performance against availability issues by subtracting Total Out of Stock Days from the Total Compliance Score for the current selection. Use it to see the net change and whether compliance improvements are being offset by stockouts (A stockout occurs when inventory reaches zero and demand cannot be fulfilled) across the same filters, time period, or business dimensions.
metrics.title: Compliance Score (Planogram Compliance) vs Out of Stock Days (Planogram Compliance) Change

metrics.description: Compares stock availability impact to range review activity by calculating the net difference between total out-of-stock days (from Planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) Compliance) and the total number of decisions recorded (from Range Review Outcomes). Use it to track how stock-out days are changing relative to decision volume across time, stores, products, or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Out of Stock Days (Planogram Compliance) vs Decision Count (Range Review Outcome) Change

metrics.description: Compares decision volume to product rating levels by subtracting the total of average product ratings from the total decision count. Use it to see whether the number of range review decisions is higher or lower relative to overall ratings for the current product, time, and other report filters.
metrics.title: Decision Count (Range Review Outcome) vs Avg Rating (Product Rating) Change

metrics.description: Compares overall product rating magnitude to review volume by subtracting total review count from the summed average rating values within the current filters/selection. Use it as a single variance-style indicator to see whether rating totals are moving differently than review volume, noting it combines two different units.
metrics.title: Avg Rating (Product Rating) vs Review Count (Product Rating) Change

metrics.description: Measures the net difference between total product review count and total average inventory in the current analysis context. Use it to compare how changes in customer review volume stack up against inventory levels and identify which side is driving the gap.
metrics.title: Review Count (Product Rating) vs Avg Inventory (Assortment Efficiency) Change

metrics.description: Measures the gap between overall average inventory and overall sell-through rate for the current slice of data (for example by time, product, or location). Use it to see whether inventory levels are increasing or decreasing relative to sell-through performance within the same context.
metrics.title: Avg Inventory (Assortment Efficiency) vs Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) Change

metrics.description: Total units sold from the Assortment Efficiency dataset, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare in-store unit volume across Assortment Efficiency dimensions such as product, location, or time.
metrics.title: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total units sold from the Assortment Efficiency dataset, filtered to sales made through the Online channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare online sales volume (in units) across relevant dimensions such as product, time period, or other segmentations (the process of dividing customers or data into groups by shared characteristics) available in Assortment Efficiency.
metrics.title: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total units sold from the Assortment Efficiency data, filtered to the North region. Use this metric to monitor and compare North’s sales volume (in units) across relevant Assortment Efficiency breakdowns.
metrics.title: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) — North Region

metrics.description: Total margin from the Daily Product Performance data, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to track and compare in-store profitability across products, dates, and other report filters.
metrics.title: Margin (Daily Product Performance) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Total margin from the Daily Product Performance data for sales made through the Online channel. Use it to monitor profitability of online sales across the selected products, dates, and other report filters.
metrics.title: Margin (Daily Product Performance) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows total margin from the Daily Product Performance data, filtered to the North region. Use it to track and compare profitability for North across the selected products, dates, and other report filters.
metrics.title: Margin (Daily Product Performance) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the total markdown amount from Markdown Events, limited to the In-Store sales channel. Use it to track and compare the value of in-store markdowns across the selected time period, products, or locations.
metrics.title: Markdown Amount (Markdown Event) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total value of markdowns from Markdown Event data, filtered to the Online sales channel. Use it to monitor markdown impact in online sales and compare results over time, by product, or across other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Markdown Amount (Markdown Event) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total markdown amount from markdown events, filtered to the North region. Use it to track and compare markdown impact in North across whatever time, store, or product scope is applied in a report.
metrics.title: Markdown Amount (Markdown Event) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the total Planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) Compliance Score, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use it to monitor overall in-store planogram compliance for the currently selected locations, time period, and other analysis filters.
metrics.title: Compliance Score (Planogram Compliance) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total Planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) Compliance Score for the Online sales channel. Use this metric to monitor overall planogram compliance performance for online activity within the current analysis scope (such as the selected time period or locations).
metrics.title: Compliance Score (Planogram Compliance) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Total planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) compliance score for locations in the North region. Use this metric to track overall planogram compliance performance for North, respecting any additional report filters such as time period or location scope.
metrics.title: Compliance Score (Planogram Compliance) — North Region

metrics.description: Total out-of-stock days from the Planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) Compliance data, filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to track and compare in-store availability issues over time or across stores, products, and other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Out of Stock Days (Planogram Compliance) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Measures the total number of out-of-stock days from Planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) Compliance data, filtered to the Online sales channel. Use it to track online availability issues and compare stock-outs over time or across products and locations within the online channel.
metrics.title: Out of Stock Days (Planogram Compliance) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the total number of out-of-stock days from Planogram (a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves) Compliance data for the North region. Use it to monitor stock availability issues in North and analyze stock-out impact by time, store, product, or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: Out of Stock Days (Planogram Compliance) — North Region

metrics.description: Counts the total number of Range Review Outcome decisions, limited to the In-Store sales channel. Use it to track and compare in-store decision volume over time or across categories and other business breakdowns.
metrics.title: Decision Count (Range Review Outcome) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Counts the total number of Range Review Outcome decisions recorded for the Online sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare online decision volume across time, categories, or other reporting dimensions.
metrics.title: Decision Count (Range Review Outcome) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Counts the total number of Range Review Outcome decisions for the North region. Use it to track decision volume in North and slice or trend it by other dimensions (such as time or category) in reports.
metrics.title: Decision Count (Range Review Outcome) — North Region

metrics.description: Average product rating limited to sales made through the In-Store channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare in-store customer ratings against other channels or overall performance for the selected products and time period.
metrics.title: Avg Rating (Product Rating) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Average product rating filtered to the Online sales channel. Use it to monitor and compare product ratings for online-only performance across the currently selected products and any applied time or other filters.
metrics.title: Avg Rating (Product Rating) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Average product rating limited to items in the North region. Use it to evaluate and compare rating performance for the North region against other regions or across different time periods under the same filters.
metrics.title: Avg Rating (Product Rating) — North Region

metrics.description: Counts the total number of product rating reviews for the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to monitor in-store review volume and compare it against other time periods or segments.
metrics.title: Review Count (Product Rating) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Counts the total number of product rating reviews for the Online sales channel only. Use it to track online review volume and compare online performance against other channels or segments.
metrics.title: Review Count (Product Rating) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Counts the total number of product rating reviews for the North region only. Use it to monitor review volume in North and compare it with other regions or overall review totals.
metrics.title: Review Count (Product Rating) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the average inventory from the Assortment Efficiency data filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use it to monitor and compare in-store inventory levels for assortment efficiency across the selected time period, products, or locations.
metrics.title: Avg Inventory (Assortment Efficiency) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Average inventory level from the Assortment Efficiency data, filtered to the Online sales channel. Use this metric to monitor and compare the inventory held for online assortments across the current analysis context (such as time period, products, or locations).
metrics.title: Avg Inventory (Assortment Efficiency) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the total average inventory from the Assortment Efficiency data, limited to locations in the North region. Use it to monitor overall inventory levels for the North region while analyzing assortment efficiency across any selected time period, products, or other filters.
metrics.title: Avg Inventory (Assortment Efficiency) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the overall assortment sell-through rate, specifically filtered to the In-Store sales channel. Use this metric to assess how effectively in-store assortments are selling through under the current report filters and grouping.
metrics.title: Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) specifically for the Online sales channel, reflecting how efficiently online inventory is converting into sales within the current report or dashboard context. Use it to monitor and compare online sell-through performance across time periods or versus other channels when used alongside similar channel-specific metrics.
metrics.title: Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) metric scoped to the North region, showing overall sell-through performance under the current report filters. Use it to assess how efficiently the assortment is selling in North and compare results across time periods or against other regions.
metrics.title: Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in in-store Units Sold for Assortment Efficiency by subtracting last month’s units from the current month (using the Month/Year period). Use it to track how in-store unit volume is trending over time and to compare changes across relevant Assortment Efficiency breakdowns.
metrics.title: MoM: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in online Units Sold within the Assortment Efficiency subject area, calculated as the current month’s units minus the prior month’s units. Use it to track how online sales volume is trending over time and to compare changes by product or other Assortment Efficiency dimensions.
metrics.title: MoM: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in Units Sold for the North region within the Assortment Efficiency subject area. Use it to understand how many more or fewer units were sold compared with the prior month and to monitor short-term sales momentum.
metrics.title: MoM: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in total in-store margin by comparing the current month’s in-store margin to the prior month. Use it to monitor how in-store profitability is trending over time, especially when reporting by Month/Year.
metrics.title: MoM: Margin (Daily Product Performance) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in Margin for the Online sales channel by comparing the current month’s margin to the prior month. Use it to see whether online profitability is improving or declining month to month for the selected products and dates.
metrics.title: MoM: Margin (Daily Product Performance) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Measures the month-over-month change in total Margin for the North region by comparing the current month’s margin to the prior month. Use it to monitor how North profitability is trending over time in the Daily Product Performance analysis.
metrics.title: MoM: Margin (Daily Product Performance) — North Region

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in total markdown amount from Markdown Events for the In-Store channel by comparing the current month to the previous month. Use it to monitor whether in-store markdown activity is rising or falling over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Markdown Amount (Markdown Event) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in Online Channel markdown amount from Markdown Event data by comparing the current month to the previous month. Use it to see whether online markdown impact is rising or falling over time and to analyze the change by product or other business dimensions.
metrics.title: MoM: Markdown Amount (Markdown Event) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in Markdown Amount from markdown events for the North region by comparing the current month to the prior month. Use it to see whether markdown impact in North is increasing or decreasing over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Markdown Amount (Markdown Event) — North Region

metrics.description: Measures the month-over-month change in the In-Store Planogram Compliance Score by comparing the current month to the previous month. Use it to track whether in-store planogram compliance is improving or declining over time for the selected locations and date range. A planogram is a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves.
metrics.title: MoM: Compliance Score (Planogram Compliance) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in the Planogram Compliance Score for the Online sales channel by comparing the current month’s score to the previous month. Use it to see whether online planogram compliance performance is improving or declining over time within the selected reporting scope. A planogram is a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves.
metrics.title: MoM: Compliance Score (Planogram Compliance) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in the North Region’s Planogram Compliance Score by comparing the current month to the prior month. Use it to monitor whether planogram compliance performance in the North region is improving or declining over time, taking into account any other report filters applied. A planogram is a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves.
metrics.title: MoM: Compliance Score (Planogram Compliance) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in In-Store out-of-stock days from Planogram Compliance by subtracting the prior month’s value from the current month. Use it to monitor whether in-store availability is improving or worsening over time and to compare trends across slices such as store or product. A planogram is a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves.
metrics.title: MoM: Out of Stock Days (Planogram Compliance) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in total out-of-stock days based on Planogram Compliance, limited to the Online channel. Use it to quickly assess whether online stock availability is improving or worsening compared with the prior month. A planogram is a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves.
metrics.title: MoM: Out of Stock Days (Planogram Compliance) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in Out of Stock Days from Planogram Compliance for the North region by comparing the current month to the prior month. Use it to monitor whether stock availability in North is improving or worsening over time, and to analyze the change when slicing by store, product, or other dimensions. A planogram is a diagram specifying exact product placement on retail shelves.
metrics.title: MoM: Out of Stock Days (Planogram Compliance) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the number of Range Review Outcome decisions for the In-Store sales channel by comparing the current month’s decision count to the previous month. Use it to monitor whether in-store decision volume is trending up or down over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Decision Count (Range Review Outcome) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the number of Range Review Outcome decisions for the Online sales channel, calculated as the current month’s decision count minus the prior month’s count.
metrics.title: MoM: Decision Count (Range Review Outcome) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the number of Range Review Outcome decisions in the North region by comparing the current month’s decision count to the prior month.
metrics.title: MoM: Decision Count (Range Review Outcome) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the average product rating for the In-Store sales channel. Use it to monitor whether in-store customer ratings are improving or declining compared with the previous month.
metrics.title: MoM: Avg Rating (Product Rating) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in average product rating for the Online sales channel by comparing the current month’s average rating to the previous month. Use it to track whether online customer ratings are improving or declining over time under the currently applied filters.
metrics.title: MoM: Avg Rating (Product Rating) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the North region’s average product rating by subtracting last month’s average rating from the current month’s value. Use it to track whether product ratings in the North are improving or declining over time at a monthly granularity.
metrics.title: MoM: Avg Rating (Product Rating) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the number of product rating reviews submitted through the In-Store sales channel, comparing the current month to the previous month. Use it to track whether in-store review volume is increasing or decreasing over time at a monthly level.
metrics.title: MoM: Review Count (Product Rating) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the number of product rating reviews coming from the Online channel, calculated as this month’s review count minus last month’s. Use it to monitor whether online review volume is increasing or decreasing over time at a Month/Year level.
metrics.title: MoM: Review Count (Product Rating) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in Product Rating review volume for the North region, calculated as this month’s review count minus the previous month’s. Use it to track whether review activity in North is increasing or decreasing over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Review Count (Product Rating) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in average inventory for the In-Store channel, based on the Assortment Efficiency average inventory measure. Use it to track how in-store inventory levels moved versus the previous month when analyzing trends over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Avg Inventory (Assortment Efficiency) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in average inventory for the Online channel by comparing the current month’s average inventory to the previous month. Use it to see whether online inventory levels are rising or falling over time within your current analysis context.
metrics.title: MoM: Avg Inventory (Assortment Efficiency) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in average inventory for locations in the North region within the Assortment Efficiency analysis. Use it to compare this month’s average inventory level to the prior month when monitoring inventory trends over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Avg Inventory (Assortment Efficiency) — North Region

metrics.description: Tracks the month-over-month change in the In-Store Sell-Through Rate (assortment efficiency) by comparing the current month’s rate to the prior month. Use it to monitor whether in-store assortment performance is improving or declining over time under the same report filters and breakdowns.
metrics.title: MoM: Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in the Online Channel Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) by comparing the current month’s rate to the previous month (using Month/Year). Use it to see whether online inventory is converting into sales more or less efficiently over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Shows the month-over-month change in Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) for the North region, comparing the current month’s rate to the prior month. Use it to quickly see whether sell-through efficiency in North is improving or declining over time.
metrics.title: MoM: Sell-Through Rate (Assortment Efficiency) — North Region

metrics.description: Calculates the year-over-year percent change in Units Sold for the In-Store channel, comparing the current period to the previous year. Use it to track in-store unit volume growth or decline over time and across relevant dimensions (for example, product or location).
metrics.title: YoY: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) — In-Store Channel

metrics.description: Measures the year-over-year percentage change in Units Sold for the Online channel, comparing the current period to the same metric in the prior year. Use it to track whether online unit volume is growing or declining over time.
metrics.title: YoY: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) — Online Channel

metrics.description: Calculates the year-over-year percentage change in Units Sold for Assortment Efficiency in the North region, comparing the current year to the previous year. Use it to track how North’s unit sales volume is growing or declining versus last year.
metrics.title: YoY: Units Sold (Assortment Efficiency) — North Region

metrics.description: Shows the year-over-year percentage change in in-store margin, comparing the current period’s margin to the same measure in the previous year. Use it to track whether in-store profitability is improving or declining over time and across report breakdowns.

sql.statement:
SELECT
    p.product_id,
    p.category_id,
    SUM(ol.quantity) AS units_sold,
    SUM(inv.on_hand_units) AS avg_inventory,
    SUM(ol.quantity) / NULLIF(SUM(inv.on_hand_units), 0) AS sell_through_rate
FROM {{ datasource_schema }}.dim_product p
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_order_line ol ON p.product_id = ol.product_id
LEFT JOIN {{ datasource_schema }}.fact_inventory_snapshot_daily inv ON p.product_id = inv.product_id
GROUP BY 1, 2
